preservation_conditions.name: non_null_participation_preserved

preservation_conditions.description: Reduction must maintain results within the relevant admissibility window A.

preservation_conditions.name: residue_legality_preserved

preservation_conditions.name: orientation_compatibility_preserved

preservation_conditions.name: branch_pruning_does_not_destroy_required_witness
preservation_conditions.description: Reduction must remain within declared branch-width and pruning bounds, ensuring at least one witness remains where existence is required.

preservation_conditions.name: NavT_noninvertibility_preserved
preservation_conditions.description: Reduction must not assume unique preimage recovery for transport.

preservation_conditions.name: delta_nondeterminism_preserved
